page_note: This page is overwhelmingly editorial: a Gospel citation frame (the parable of the two trees from "their gospel") with disciple Q&A and polemic against rival "doctrines" (ⲁⲟⲅⲙⲁ) that interpret the two trees in a single earth/single interpretation. 91.4% damaged. Teaching purity 0.000 — no cosmological substrate present. The parable uses correspondential language (good tree/bad tree) but enters via NT citation ("written in their gospel"), which is a 3rd-c. Manichaean editorial act, not pre-Mani substrate teaching. Segments 15-19 and 29-34 polemicize against rival interpreters who "reckon them in a single earth" — anti-heretical polemic. Seam at i=20 ("Then said our Lord, the Anointed, the Apostle...") is classic dialogue frame attribution.
